name: YoApy Social Poster
author: YoApy

sections.description:
YoApy Social Poster is a powerful WordPress plugin that enables you to schedule and publish content directly to major social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok. With an intuitive interface and robust scheduling capabilities, you can streamline your social media workflow and maintain a consistent online presence.

Key Features:

  • Multi-Platform Support: Publish to Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok from a single interface
  • Visual Planner: Intuitive drag-and-drop scheduler with real-time previews
  • Post Metabox Integration: Schedule posts directly from the WordPress editor
  • Detailed Logging: Track all publishing activities with comprehensive logs
  • Media Management: Easily upload images and videos for your social posts
  • Flexible Scheduling: Schedule posts for immediate or future publication
  • Character Limit Compliance: Automatic text truncation to meet platform requirements
  • TikTok Compliance: Full support for TikTok’s Direct Post API requirements including creator info display

Supported Post Types:

  • Regular posts with images
  • Video posts (including Reels and YouTube Shorts)
  • Stories for Facebook and Instagram
  • YouTube Live scheduling

Perfect For:

  • Bloggers and content creators
  • Marketing agencies
  • Small businesses
  • Social media managers
  • Influencers

Streamline your social media workflow and save time with YoApy Social Poster.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/yoapy-social-poster directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the YoApy -> Settings screen to configure your API credentials
  4. Start scheduling posts through the YoApy -> Planner or directly from post edit screens
sections.faq:
Do I need YoApy API credentials?

Yes, you need to register at YoApy.com and obtain API credentials to use this plugin.

Which social networks are supported?

Currently supported networks are Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

Can I schedule posts in advance?

Yes, you can schedule posts for immediate or future publication.
